name: teaser
description: Recipe v3 (owner 2026-11-22, batch 3): teaser@2 with the voice at 1.4x so the Short stays within 30 s. Batch-3 Veo Lite shots carry speech for about 7 of their 8 seconds, so at 1.25x they assembled to 30.4-33.1 s. Everything else as teaser@2: an on-screen presenter speaks to the camera in shots 1 and 5; in shots 2-4 an unseen woman narrator speaks over action shot with a named camera move; at most 18 Urdu words a line; Veo Lite, no duration argument.

presenter.description: a confident young Pakistani teacher in modest dress

prompt.head: Vertical portrait video, 8 seconds, full frame edge to edge, no letterbox or black bars.
prompt.presenter: The presenter looks straight into the camera and speaks in Urdu with a lively, quick, enthusiastic delivery: "{line}"
prompt.voice_over: An unseen woman narrator speaks in Urdu as a voice-over only, with a lively, quick, enthusiastic delivery; nobody on screen speaks: "{line}"
prompt.tail: Upbeat pace, crisp warm daylight, realistic cinematic look. Modest dress. No camera interface, viewfinder marks, frame guides or recording indicators. No on-screen text, captions, letters, logos or watermarks; any papers or screens are blurred and unreadable.
